test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question:
Consider the following statements:**1. President can dissolve Lok Sabha on his own discretion.
2. Governor appoints Chief Minister in a hung assembly.
3. Governor has no role in Money Bills.
Which of the above is/are correct**?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2 only**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• According to **Article 85(2)(b)** of the **Constitution of India**, the **President** has the power to dissolve the **Lok Sabha**. However, this is not an absolute discretionary power. The **President** generally exercises this power on the advice of the **Council of Ministers** headed by the **Prime Minister**. *Hence, statement 1 is incorrect.*
 
• In the event of a **Hung Assembly**, where no single party or pre-poll alliance gains a clear majority, the **Governor** exercises **situational discretion**. Under **Article 164**, the **Governor** is responsible for appointing the **Chief Minister** who is most likely to command the confidence of the **Legislative Assembly**. *Hence, statement 2 is correct.*
